units.en: This ⟦0⟧ requires ⟦1⟧ to form the Qing Empire via ⟦2⟧.

Take the ⟦0⟧ national focus sub-branch and build your military up. When dealing with the Bandits, one of the possible ways to deal with them is purging them, which requires that you stockpile infantry weapons then click the decision. Another way is to pacify them, which requires you have six divisions on three separate states each. The best thing to do in order to get many divisions is to pacify them. This will give several divisions of cavalry divisions. In order to pacify them, change the infantry to the weaker 3 infantry units. Train more divisions and bring the trained divisions on the field. Then, switch the cavalry to the weaker divisions. If done properly, you will only need to do one bandit event. When the ⟦1⟧ focus is reached, it is possible to recruit the cavalry from the decision and then change it to manpower by disbanding if necessary.

After dealing with the bandits, switch the divisions to the 6 infantry unit divisions. It is not necessary to upgrade the template because if you take the ⟦0⟧ focus then the ⟦1⟧ focus will give 20 width 7 infantry and 2 artillery divisions. Make sure to research artillery so it is possible to reinforce them. Build a strong army and place them on the Korean border to the east and the ⟦2⟧/ ⟦3⟧ border to the west. ⟦4⟧ may join the war against the ⟦5⟧ but do not help. This is so the Japanese will be weaker when ⟦6⟧ goes to war with them. Wait until Japan weakens China (when Japan controls most of the coast) to take the ⟦7⟧ focus. If the Japanese are close to your border, it indicates that they both haven't fought long enough.

Once ready, Take the ⟦0⟧ focus and take all of Korea first. This is so that there will only be one front needed to fight in. Have garrisons in the ports so the ⟦1⟧ don't naval invade. Take as much Chinese territory as possible. This is because if ⟦2⟧ surrenders, ⟦3⟧ will take territory belonging to the Chinese not under ⟦4⟧ control. This will also give them more surrender progress against ⟦5⟧ It may be beneficial to take the ⟦6⟧ focus to vassalize the warlords if the war is going badly. be aware that you have to annex the warlords afterwards. Peace out with ⟦7⟧ first. This way, ⟦8⟧ will control if ⟦9⟧ would white peace after they get kicked out of Asia or not. Once ⟦10⟧ has surrendered, annex all land and push ⟦11⟧ out of Asia. Once China is defeated, it is very important to take ⟦12⟧ territory first before Japan take or puppet them, because if you allow Japan to take those areas, ⟦13⟧ can invade and occupy those area and prevent you from taking the focus. To take the ⟦14⟧ focus, you will need all of mainland China minus the European treaty ports so annex all of the warlord puppets if there are any. For ⟦15⟧ achievement, do not let ⟦16⟧ peace out as you will need to annex them. The easiest way to annex ⟦17⟧ is by paratroopers, which is going to be a little harder if you accept their white peace since you have to go through Korea. You will need to build an airbase in South Korea so that you are within striking range of the mainland Japan and you will need to build some transport planes.
Alternative Strategy post No Step Back

For the focuses, rush the right side of the political focus tree and aim for Request Control of The Railways. Before unpausing, disband all of the cavalry plus 1 infantry division and have the rest train indefinitely to get some ⟦0⟧. Research trains because you do not start with it, and be sure to research Paratroopers, Support Equipment, Light Tanks, Fighters, and if possible CAS. Build 3 ⟦1⟧ and the fill the rest with ⟦2⟧. Once the first focus is complete, spend the bad guns you start with on destroying the bandits which will get you 30 ⟦3⟧, then wait until your army training give you more until you have 35 ⟦4⟧ which should be spent immediately on State Serves the Military spirit on the Officers Corps, and you can stop the military training if the divisions are already at level 3. Once you finished researching trains, you should gain control of some of your own ⟦5⟧ and put 1 factory on guns, 1 on trains, 1 on transport planes, 1 on artillery, 1 on support, and adjust them as needed. Switch the transport planes to Fighters and then CAS once you got about 3 of them. Once you reach Request Control of The Railways, you can take the redirect tools 2 times and try to get just 1 military high command, you need the ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ later. Try getting your third research slot for now, plus Invite Japanese Settlers for more ⟦8⟧, then you want to focus on taking all of the focuses at the bottom before Independence War. You will want to take the right side (Five Equal Peoples) as it gives better bonuses and the way you are going to acquire your equipment later. You want to get to Purge the Generals Affairs Council first as you can increase your conscription law for cheaper before taking the rest.

Once ⟦0⟧ forms the faction, start improving relations with ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and maybe ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ as well and also ask for military access and sign non-aggression pact with ⟦5⟧ should accept without the need of improving relations beforehand. Make sure you bank 50 ⟦6⟧ before Sino-Japanese war starts, and once the war start, you want to prepare another 100 ⟦7⟧ and 50 ⟦8⟧ to send attache to ⟦9⟧ soon after the war starts. Join the war when ⟦10⟧ calls you in and spend that 50 ⟦11⟧ on War Propaganda as soon as the decision pops up, but do not help them with your military. Do not put troops on the ⟦12⟧ border at all as ⟦13⟧ will not attack if you do. Start training large amount of divisions as you can, and improve the template as soon as you get the XP. In the mean time, with the equipment deficit, start asking for lend-lease from those you just improved relations with as well as from ⟦14⟧. Ask for everything, guns, artillery, support equipment, trucks, light tanks, aircrafts. Also, getting lend-lease from the South Americans will put you into a convoy deficit, which means you can modify your lend-lease and ask for convoys from them. You will want to get as many convoys as you can this way.

Once your ⟦0⟧ are complete, help ⟦1⟧ by building a ⟦2⟧ on the Suiyuan area and another just before the river on the ⟦3⟧ where ⟦4⟧ might have problems with supply. Take the decision to make it faster. Otherwise, focus on getting a large army of good divisions, like 24-25 width infantry with artillery and engineer support and some paratroopers. Once your military high command is filled up, you can start spending ⟦5⟧ on preparing to take ⟦6⟧ supply decision until it cannot be pressed anymore. You can take whatever focuses at this point, like improving relations with ⟦7⟧ or finish up the top left focuses you left off while you prepare. You will want at least 4 full army groups, preferably 5 or more, when you start the fight with ⟦8⟧. Once WW2 starts in Europe, you can ask for lend-lease for non-aligned countries as well.

The best time to stab ⟦0⟧ in the back would be in early 1940. If you see ⟦1⟧ started the focus ⟦2⟧ , it means you have to take the ⟦3⟧ focus immediately though you can do it earlier. To prepare, put one army group on the northern half of ⟦4⟧ border, another on the southern half, an army group on East Hebei border, a small group to push into Dalian, and 2-3 army groups including your paratroopers on the Korean border. Have them plan and set them on aggressive. Once the war starts, kick ⟦5⟧ out of Korea and try to gain as much land as possible in ⟦6⟧ (press the button for more free guns). Do not kick ⟦7⟧ out of ⟦8⟧ so they don't white peace. Build an ⟦9⟧ in South Korea and prepare to invade ⟦10⟧ from there. Try to secure a port, Hiroshima, Osaka, and the unmarked Suruga port north of Osaka are best targets. Defeating Japan should be easy as most of their troops are still in ⟦11⟧. Puppet ⟦12⟧ in the peace deal and take the islands they occupy plus Korea. ⟦13⟧ will inevitably take Taiwan so you are going to need to naval invade or paratroop there later.

With ⟦0⟧ done, if you control some area in ⟦1⟧ in the south, immediately send your troops in ⟦2⟧ there if possible. Keep pushing from Northern ⟦3⟧ and see for opportunity to naval invade. Surround Nanjing without capturing it so the Chinese troops out of supplies. Remember, you need to invade Taiwan to capitulate ⟦4⟧. Keep asking for lend-lease if you lack equipment. You should eventually win and be able to take the focus. If you want The Dragon Swallowed The Sun achievement, you can lend-lease convoys to ⟦5⟧ until you can annex them.
…and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
